decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans numbered 000, 00, 01rii, 02rii, 03rii, 04, 05rii, 06rii, Received 19 December 2011 and submitted  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The garden and boundary planting shown on Plan Number 01rii shall be completed within three months of the granting of this decision and maintained thereafter for the lifetime of the development.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, a detached outbuilding and paved driveway with crossover
